text:
emma: Hey design — need a short-form social story + ad set to support the benchmark webinar promo. High level:
- 3 IG/Stories (9:16 1080x1920) static + motion variants
- 1 hero motion loop (6s, mp4 + Lottie) for socials
- 3 LinkedIn carousel slides (1080x1080) highlighting key benchmark takeaways
- 1 1200x628 AMP ad (static + GIF fallback)
Deliverables: source Figma frames, exports @2x PNG, MP4 (H.264), Lottie JSON, and an export-ready carousel PDF.
Benchmark narrative to lean on: "Inference economics — latency vs $/token" (see brief). Need English + FR copy. Timeline: thumbnails by Tue EOD, final assets by Fri COB. Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-social-drafts  Brand kit here: https://redwood.com/brand  @ajay can you lead? :pray:

ajay: I can take lead. Quick q: do we have final vetted data points for the carousel or is this still being iterated? Also prefer to hand off Lottie JSON for the loop — is that okay?

jonathan: We have the vetted numbers in the benchmark doc — I'll drop the exact 3 datapoints to use and call out the alt phrasing so design doesn't re-run. Also prefer a compact sparkline + price-badge layout for each slide (keeps mobile copy visible).

lisa: For localization — I'll paste FR microcopy into the figma once frames exist. Also need alt text and 2–3 CTA variants (short, medium, long).

ajay: Noted. Deliverable plan: initial sketches + keyframes tomorrow 10:00 PT; motion pass by Thurs; final exports Fri. I'll produce:
```
- 3 story frames (9:16) source + PNG @2x
- 1 hero 6s mp4 (H.264) + Lottie JSON
- 3 carousel slides PNG @2x + PDF
- 1200x628 AMP ad static + GIF fallback
```
Any constraints on motion or file size?

emma: Keep motion subtle, no flashing, no rapid strobe. Target max file sizes: stories < 3MB each (motion), hero loop < 1.2MB, AMP ad GIF < 150KB if possible. Follow brand motion guidelines: https://redwood.com/brand/motion. Budgeted ~10 designer hrs + ~4 anim hrs — escalate to @jonathan if we need more.

brand-bot: Brand check: palette OK, avoid drop shadows on hero badges, minimum contrast 4.5:1 for text over images, use Redwood Secondary Accent only for price badges.

jonathan: Dropped the datapoints + spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE  Use these three callouts per slide: 1) 2x lower latency @ 25% cost, 2) 3–5x throughput on Dedicated, 3) prefix caching reduced tokens by ~18%. CTA: "Register — live Apr 9"  Please add UK time variant: "Register — Apr 9, 10:00 BST"

ajay: Got it. Will sketch frames and share a quick preview in this thread for copy/layout sign-off.

lisa: Also add UTM for tracking: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_webinar_apr9&utm_medium=organic

emma: Perfect — thanks team :rocket: Will review initial frames tomorrow morning.
